title: Jar with press-fit lid (IR v1)
prompt: Small round jar with a press-fit lid, printed side by side, each as a single solid. Jar: 50 mm outside diameter, 40 mm tall, 2 mm walls and a 2 mm floor. Lid: a 50 mm diameter, 2 mm thick disc with a 5 mm tall plug ring on one side that fits inside the jar: 45.6 mm outside diameter (0.2 mm clearance) and 1.5 mm wall; print it plug side up. Jar centred on the origin, lid centred 60 mm along +X, both standing on Z = 0.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
The jar: Ø50 × 40 centred on the origin
The lid: Ø50, 7 mm with its plug, centred at x = 60
Five cylindrical faces: jar outside and inside, lid rim, plug outside and inside

notes: IR v1 rewrite of t2-jar-with-lid: the jar is a shelled cylinder and the plug ring is joined to the lid (v0 needed revolved profiles).
